CVE-2026-138026 [MCP]: Crypto APIs MCP server packages (@cryptoapis-io/mcp-*) before 0.4.0, mcp-blockchain-events, mcp-blockchain-fees, mcp-broadcast and mcp-prepare-transactions before 0.5.0, and mcp-aml before 0.2.0 contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to invoke tools using the operator's API key. When started with Streamable HTTP transport and --api-key, the server binds 0.0.0.0 and exposes /mcp, letting attackers consume paid credits, read account data, redirect event subscriptions, and delete HD wallet xPubs.

CVE-2026-138027 [MCP]: Bagel (bagel-mcp) before 2.5.5 exposes unsandboxed DuckDB SQL execution through the read-only annotated query_messages MCP tool, allowing file access and network requests. Attackers who prompt-inject the driving LLM via recorded logs or topics can invoke read_csv_auto, COPY TO, or httpfs to read and write files and perform server-side request forgery.

CVE-2026-138032 [MCP]: WhoDB from 0.88.0 before 0.132.0 contains an access control bypass in the MCP whodb_query tool, letting callers run file-writing statements without approval because the sqlguard keyword classifier omits INTO, OUTFILE and DUMPFILE. MCP clients or prompt-injected models can execute PostgreSQL lo_export or MySQL SELECT INTO OUTFILE to create files on the database host and create tables, bypassing confirmation and read-only modes.

CVE-2026-138033 [MCP]: mcp-video-analyzer 0.2.0 before 0.10.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to reach internal addresses by supplying any http(s) URL ending in a video extension. Attackers can use prompt injection to make tools like get_frames fetch loopback, private, or cloud metadata addresses directly or via redirects, writing responses to disk or returning rendered screenshots.

CVE-2026-138034 [MCP]: bigcommerce-api-mcp before 1.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to invoke MCP tools because the /sse and /messages routes skip the authenticateRequest middleware. Attackers can open /sse to obtain a session id and POST JSON-RPC tool calls to /messages to retrieve store product, order and customer records using the operator's BigCommerce API key.
